factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED

factual_claims.claim: Regarding business operations, the company continued its core activity of real estate development on its 13.2-hectare property in Pärnu, maintaining its strategy to sell existing land plots while remaining open to rental property development or other opportunities if they arise.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management report: 'AS Trigon Property Development owned one development project with an area of 13.2 hectares in the City of Pärnu... The Company’s objective is to find companies willing to bring their business activities... The Company does not have any plan to change or start a new business activity... will continue to sell of land plots... does not preclude the possibility of developing existing land into rental property if the opportunity arises.'

factual_claims.claim: The company had no employees during either reporting period.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Personnel section: 'AS Trigon Property Development had no employees as at 31 December 2025 and as at 31 December 2024.'

factual_claims.claim: On the stock exchange, the closing share price of AS Trigon Property Development increased slightly to 0.634 euros at the end of 2025 from 0.620 euros at the end of 2024, resulting in a higher market capitalization of 2,852,405 euros compared with 2,789,418 euros in the prior year.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Financial ratios table: Closing price of share 2025 = 0.634 EUR, 2024 = 0.620 EUR. Market capitalisation 2025 = 2,852,405 EUR, 2024 = 2,789,418 EUR.

factual_claims.claim: Meanwhile, the book value of the share decreased to 0.39 euros from 0.41 euros, and a total of 146,813 shares were traded during the year with a total turnover of 96,814 euros.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 7: Book value of share 2025 = 0.39 EUR, 2024 = 0.41 EUR. Share section: 'In 2025, a total of 146,813 shares were traded and the total turnover amounted to 96,814 euros.'
